bead.title: Specify hybrid-async debt, backpressure, and crash matrix gates
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The technical design describes committed command ordering, snapshots, and commit-latency tradeoffs, but it does not define async apply debt/backpressure metrics or a crash matrix proving the async contract across manifest, memory, SQLite, high-water, and repair boundaries.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:478` through `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:488` define committed sequence ordering and snapshot triggers, and `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:557` through `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:571` define commit-latency and replay-response expectations, but the design does not define async debt/backpressure metrics or crash cases for before manifest commit, after manifest before memory render, after memory render before response delivery, during async SQLite apply, after SQLite high-water advancement, during repair, and perf release-lane load.

PROPOSED FIX: Update governing artifact `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md` to define async apply debt metrics, backpressure thresholds, poison thresholds, and a normative crash/perf matrix for `objectlog/hybrid-async`. The matrix must cover crash before manifest commit, after manifest before memory render, after memory render before response delivery, during async SQLite apply, after SQLite high-water advancement, during repair, and under perf release-lane load.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementing metrics, repair tools, or performance tests; changing existing evidence results; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncDebtBackpressureTdSpec: `rg -n 'hybrid-async|backpressure|debt|async apply|lag|poison|sqlite_high_water' docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md` succeeds and shows bounded async apply debt metrics, backpressure rules, and poison thresholds.
2. TestHybridAsyncCrashPerfMatrixTdSpec: `rg -n 'crash matrix|perf matrix|before manifest|after manifest|memory render|response delivery|SQLite apply|high-water|during repair|release-lane' docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md` succeeds and shows every required crash/perf matrix row.
3. TestHybridAsyncDebtBackpressureNoCodeScope: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`.
4. TestHybridAsyncDebtBackpressureCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncDebtBackpressureFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
6. TestHybridAsyncDebtBackpressureGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
7. TestHybridAsyncDebtBackpressureLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
